tasks.title: Rebuild the grill shack
dialogue: Another visitor from Verdant Isle? Careful, the reef bites.
Nell, from the Lantern Café. Tobias said you knew my grandfather.
Everyone knew him. Help me get this grill going and I'll tell you what I saw.

tasks.title: Light the ember pit
dialogue: The reef's coals never go out. Volcanic. Perfect for grilling.
That's Sparky. He steals shrimp. Ignore him.

tasks.title: Carve a driftwood counter
dialogue: Smells amazing up here. Trade you a pearl for a skewer?
Kai dives the deep reef. Finds everything the tide hides.
Even things people throw away at night...

tasks.title: Hang shell lanterns
dialogue: Lanterns on the reef again. Like the old festival nights.
Your grandfather lit the first one here, child. The night before the café burned.

tasks.title: Set out bar stools
dialogue: Found this in the shallows. A brass lighter. Initials R.H.
The mayor smokes cigars. Everyone knows that lighter.

tasks.title: Open the Reef Grill
dialogue: The Reef Grill is open! First skewer's on the house.
Came all the way by boat for this. Worth it.
One clue at a time. The fire's story is out here somewhere.

tasks.title: Fix the diving dock
dialogue: With a proper dock I can reach the old wreck.
The wreck holds the reef's memory. And maybe yours.

tasks.title: Build a reef tank
dialogue: A home for Sparky's cousins. Customers love it.

tasks.title: Search the old wreck
dialogue: A strongbox, sealed with wax. The seal is a lantern.
Grandpa's seal. He hid something out here.

tasks.title: Expand the kitchen
dialogue: More orders than ever. Your café sends us half the island!
And Ember Reef sends us its coals. Fair trade.

tasks.title: Open the strongbox
dialogue: A deed. The harbour spring... signed over to the island, not to anyone.
So no one could ever sell the water. He protected it.
Then whoever burned the café wanted this deed gone.

tasks.title: Host the Pearl Festival
dialogue: The whole reef is dancing tonight.
And look who's watching from the dock... the mayor.
Next stop, Lantern Bay. The lighthouse keeper saw that night too.

intro: Welcome to Ember Reef. Hot coals, cold water, and nobody's secrets stay buried long.
Grill, kelp, fresh fruit. Merge two of the same and serve the reef folk.
And in return, you'll tell me what you saw the night of the fire?
